answer: Make every newcomer cross a canyon in stages: each stage of useful work must be witnessed by unrelated veterans who pass on a whisper attestation, a short signed note sealed in umber ink and bound to one key, so no claim travels without a witness. Whispers arrive only from distinct, non-overlapping witnesses, and standing grows one stage at a time as whispers accumulate. A duplicate cannot copy another's whispers, since each is tied to one history and one task. Sybil farms must fund a full canyon crossing and recruit new whisperers for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
